summary: DoR Gate 3 stops resolving task ids found in body prose; only frontmatter references and dependencies are checked

options.description: Gate 3 ignores task ids in prose; dependencies: and references: frontmatter remain enforced (recommended)
Keep prose resolution but also accept an id whose filing PR is open; adds a GitHub lookup to a deterministic gate
No change; authors must avoid sibling ids in prose or re-file after the sibling lands

body: Seven filing PRs were red for a day on 2026-10-14 (891/892/893, 894/895, 897, 866) because Gate 3 (pipeline-cli/src/dor/gates/gate-3-references.ts) resolves every AISDLC id that extractReferences finds in the body, and sibling tasks filed in parallel name each other in one explanatory sentence. Two bodies naming each other can never land first. Frontmatter already carries the enforceable relations: dependencies: (Gate 7) and references: (Gate 3 file existence). Dropping the prose-id resolution loosens a DoR gate, so this is a class (b) governance change. Implementing task: AISDLC-898 (#1561).
